explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: Corvale East has 22 days of lisinopril on hand and Corvale General has 23 days on hand.
The product label lists Aurobindo Pharma Limited as a registered manufacturing plant with FEI 3004021229.
FDA inspection 684552 of that plant ended on 2010-09-24 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2010-12-23.
Subsequent inspections of the same plant from 2011 through 2023 were all classified VAI.
The label also names APL HEALTHCARE LIMITED (FEI 3011895410) as a registered plant, whose most recent inspection in 2025-12-17 was VAI.

rejected.text: That OAI classification occurred 5724 days before the posting date of 2026-10-21.
rejected.reason: date 2026-10-21 is not in the cited evidence

rejected.text: The best option by rule is to buy from A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 5724 days before the posting
rejected.reason: headline: number 5724 is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-b99ec6.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%lisinopril%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%lisinopril%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-539850.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('0e6364a4-6d66-4151-8197-d45e2a762895') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-08f2cb.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%lisinopril%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-c93154.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%lisinopril%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-c28acf.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%lisinopril%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-d36c7b.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3011895410', '3004021229') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-1564c0.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3011895410', '3004021229') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-3e2025.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3011895410', '3004021229') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('apl', 'aurobindo')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-4e5b2c.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('apl', 'aurobindo') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%lisinopril%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-1aae22.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('684552') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-42ee93.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('65862003901')
